activity_summary: The jaw had not become a face. The clove was already in. You named Titus and no side. The loaf was a penny, a full thumb short of the notch. You ate three soft bites. She told you that less from the clove, if it comes, is not a cure.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Named the title, ate the soft of the loaf, and did not call anything a cure.

entities.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell
entities.context: Measured the thumb, asked the bill, and kept the crust.

entities.name: Alse Pinder
entities.context: Put the rest under the cloth.

entities.name: a penny loaf
